text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $62,900 while Ethereum edges up slightly, both showing modest resilience despite extreme fear sentiment at 23. Bitcoin's rising dominance to 55.7% suggests money is rotating toward the safest major asset as SOL and other alts decline, though the $52B daily volume remains relatively light for capitulation-level fear. The 5-point improvement in fear over the past week hints at a possible stabilization, though conviction remains weak.
